decision: Can a TensorLBM corotational 2-node beam element (energy-consistent, exact tangent, Newmark-beta + Newton) reproduce, within the owner 15% criterion, (a) the external analytic/numerical references (Euler-Bernoulli modal frequency, exact elastica, exact circular-arc pure-bending solution) and (b) the same KPIs produced by a faithful transplant of the mature OSS implementation joconnor22/LIFE (src/FEMElement.cpp forceVector/stiffMatrix/setLocalMatrices + src/FEMBody.cpp Newmark/Newton)? And is the transplant's (M1+M2)/L0 transverse-force denominator measurable in the KPIs?

alternatives.A_TL: TensorLBM arm: formulation='consistent'. Element derived from strain energy U = EA/(2L0)(L-L0)^2 + EI/L0*(2th1^2+2th1th2+2th2^2); internal force g = dU/dq (transverse nodal force uses the CURRENT length L); tangent = exact Hessian dg/dq. Newmark-beta (beta=0.25, gamma=0.5) with consistent mass, identical integrator.
alternatives.A_LIFE: OSS transplant arm: formulation='life'. Line-faithful port of joconnor22/LIFE: u=(L^2-L0^2)/(L+L0); F0=EA/L0*u; M1=2EI/L0*(2th1+th2); M2=2EI/L0*(th1+2th2); local f=[-F0,(M1+M2)/L0,M1,F0,-(M1+M2)/L0,M2]; K=T^T(K_L+K_NL)T with K_NL from F0 and V0=f[4]; same Newmark (alpha=0.25, delta=0.5) and same Newton outer loop.
alternatives.A_REF_ANALYTIC: External references, computed independently of both FEM arms: (i) clamped-free Euler-Bernoulli eigenvalues from cos(kL)cosh(kL)=-1 by bisection; (ii) exact planar elastica under a tip transverse load by elliptic-type 1-D quadrature (ds = dtheta/sqrt(2P(sin th0 - sin theta)/EI)) cross-checked by an ODE boundary-value shooting solve of EI*theta'' + P*cos(theta)=0; (iii) exact circular-arc solution for a pure end moment (R=EI/M, tip = (R sin phi, R(1-cos phi))).

hypothesis: H1 (transplant fidelity): every KPI differs by < 15% between A_TL and A_LIFE at the predeclared configurations, i.e. the LIFE transplant reproduces the corotated beam response inside the owner criterion. H2 (external accuracy): every KPI of BOTH arms is within 15% of the external reference at the finest predeclared discretisation. H3 (measured mechanism, diagnostic): A_LIFE's transverse denominator L0 instead of L makes its internal force vector differ from grad(U) by a relative amount that scales with (L-L0)/L0, while A_TL matches grad(U) to machine precision. H0/falsifier for H1: |Delta| >= 15% on at least one KPI; falsifier for H2: any KPI off the external reference by >= 15% at the finest discretisation.

cases.S1_LINEAR_STATIC: Straight cantilever, L=1, EI=1, rho*A=0, EA=1e8, clamped at node 0, tip transverse point load P with P*L^2/EI = 0.004 (small-deflection regime), 1 load step.
cases.S2_ELASTICA: Straight cantilever, L=1, EI=1, EA=1e6, clamped at node 0, tip transverse point load with lambda = P*L^2/EI in {1,2,5,10} (large deflection), incremental load stepping with substepping on Newton failure.
cases.S3_PURE_MOMENT: Straight cantilever, L=1, EI=1, EA=1e6, clamped at node 0, pure end moment M with phi = M*L/EI in {pi/2, pi} (exact circular arc).
cases.D1_MODAL: Linearised clamped-free cantilever, L=1, EI=1, rho*A=1, EA=1e6: first 3 frequencies from the generalised eigenproblem vs analytic (kL)^2.
cases.D2_NEWMARK_TIME: Free vibration of the linearised (small amplitude) cantilever, n_elem=16, 20 measured periods, dt = T1/50, T1/100, T1/200, T1/400: Newmark period error relative to the discrete model's own omega1 and observed order in dt.
cases.D3_NONLINEAR_ENERGY: Large-amplitude free vibration: static preload lambda=5, then release with zero velocity; 10 fundamental periods at dt=T1/200; relative drift of total mechanical energy (exact reference: 0, since gamma=0.5/beta=0.25 is non-dissipative).

unit_of_analysis: one solver arm (formulation) at one fixed discretisation/timestep of one predeclared case; each KPI is a scalar per arm

baseline_control.baseline: the external analytic/numerical reference of each case (A_REF_ANALYTIC)
baseline_control.control: A_LIFE is the control arm that shares geometry, mesh, boundary conditions, mass matrix, Newmark parameters, Newton loop and post-processing with A_TL; the only changed variable is the element formulation (force vector + tangent). This isolates the formulation choice without confounders.
confounder_controls: identical initial node sets and identical element-length vectors for both arms
identical Newmark update, identical BC elimination, identical convergence test norm
identical post-processing functions (node_position/tip_rotation) for both arms
no tuning of either formulation after inspecting KPIs; the element ladder and dt ladder are fixed below

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: an error is |KPI - reference|/|reference|*100 and must be < 15% for H1 (arm vs arm) and H2 (arm vs external reference at the finest ladder point)

convergence_rule.S2_S3: a KPI is mesh-converged when |KPI(n=32) - KPI(n=16)| / |KPI(n=32)| < 1%
convergence_rule.D2: time-converged when halving dt changes the period error by a factor in [3.0, 5.0] (2nd order band)

predeclared_thresholds.stability_rule: non-finite values, or |displacement| > 1e3 * L, or a Newton solve that fails to reach the residual tolerance after maxit=30 with load substepping -> the run is declared FAILED and reported, never tuned or silently replaced

stopping_rule: Fixed ladders inspected once: n_elem in {2,4,8,16,32} for S2/S3/D1, dt in {T1/50,T1/100,T1/200,T1/400} for D2, 10 periods for D3, lambda in {1,2,5,10}, phi in {pi/2,pi}. No run is extended or truncated after looking at the KPIs. Total wall-clock budget 900 s; per-run budget 120 s.
repetition_rationale: The model is deterministic (no stochastic input): repetitions are replaced by (i) two independent reference routes for the elastica (1-D quadrature and ODE BVP shooting, required to agree to <1e-6 before use) and (ii) a five-point element ladder plus a four-point dt ladder, which quantify discretisation variability instead of sampling noise. Confirmation of any KPI claim therefore rests on ladder convergence, not single runs.

environment.hardware: local control node (all runs are seconds-scale; no cluster submission needed)

analysis: KPIs are extracted programmatically (never typed by hand) into xval/corotational_beam_newmark/table.csv + summary.json; percentages are computed from the stored floats; pass/fail uses the single 15% owner threshold; no outlier removal, no post-hoc filtering. Any run flagged by the stability rule is reported as FAILED with its stage name.
interpretation_limits: Structure only: the fluid (LBM/IBM) coupling of LIFE -- implicit IBM force mapping, block Gauss-Seidel coupling, Aitken under-relaxation -- is explicitly out of scope; nothing here validates FSI behaviour.
Euler-Bernoulli kinematics: no shear deformation, no axial-moment coupling; conclusions do not transfer to stocky members.
The external references are planar elastica / linear modal / circular-arc solutions, i.e. they validate geometric nonlinearity and time integration, not material nonlinearity, buckling or contact.
The LIFE transplant is a method transplant into the TensorLBM integrator, not a binary-level run of LIFE (its Newton/Newmark code path is the same, but LAPACK/OpenMP/IBM coupling are not exercised).
